ThingDef.label: rift needler core
ThingDef.description: Slot: Main weapon. Compatible chassis: Medium. Role: anti-light sustained fire. Effect: gives a modular turret chassis a fast 3-shot rift-needle burst for light enemies, animals, and swarm pressure. Range: 28.5. Cooldown: 2.5s. Burst: 3. Extra module power draw: 0 W. Does nothing by itself until installed in a compatible chassis.

ThingDef.label: plasma lance core
ThingDef.description: Slot: Main weapon. Compatible chassis: Medium. Role: anti-armor lance. Effect: replaces the turret main weapon with a slower long-range ultra-plasma bolt for armor, elites, and early boss pressure. Range: 33.5. Cooldown: 4.3s. Burst: 1. Extra module power draw: +120 W. Does nothing by itself until installed in a compatible chassis.

ThingDef.label: ash choir repeater core
ThingDef.description: Slot: Main weapon. Compatible chassis: Medium. Role: anti-swarm ash repeater. Effect: fires a fast five-shot burst of ash-canticle shards for wave control and light target suppression. Poor armor penetration keeps it dependent on lance or rail modules against elites and bosses. Range: 30.5. Cooldown: 3.5s. Burst: 5. Extra module power draw: +180 W. Unlock: 320 forge residue. Does nothing by itself until installed in a compatible chassis.

ThingDef.label: choir arc emitter
ThingDef.description: Slot: Auxiliary. Compatible chassis: Medium. Role: secondary crowd pressure. Effect: adds an independent timed canticle-wave support shot while the main weapon keeps firing normally. Range: 30.0. Auxiliary cooldown: 7.0s. Burst: 1. Extra module power draw: +130 W. Does nothing by itself until installed in a compatible chassis.

ThingDef.label: cooling lattice
ThingDef.description: Slot: Passive. Compatible chassis: Medium. Role: cadence stabilizer. Effect: reduces installed main weapon cooldown by 16%, making the turret fire more often. Main weapon cooldown: -16%. Extra module power draw: +70 W. Does nothing by itself until installed in a compatible chassis.

ThingDef.label: targeting sigil
ThingDef.description: Slot: Passive. Compatible chassis: Medium. Role: range and tracking. Effect: adds +3.5 cells to installed main weapon range and reserves a small future accuracy hook. Main weapon range: +3.5 cells. Extra module power draw: +80 W. Does nothing by itself until installed in a compatible chassis.

ThingDef.label: residue capacitor
ThingDef.description: Slot: Passive. Compatible chassis: Medium. Role: charge buffer. Effect: adds +1.5 cells to installed main weapon range and reduces installed main weapon cooldown by 8%. Main weapon range: +1.5 cells. Main weapon cooldown: -8%. Extra module power draw: +120 W. Does nothing by itself until installed in a compatible chassis.

ThingDef.label: sepulcher rail core
ThingDef.description: Slot: Main weapon. Compatible chassis: Medium. Role: charged anti-elite rail sniper. Effect: charges two massive gauss accelerator planks, then launches a single Sepulcher rail spike through the open centerline. Range: 52.0. Minimum range: 8.0. Charge: 2.5s before firing; passive cadence modules reduce this charge time. Cooldown: 12.0s after firing. Burst: 1. Extra module power draw: +520 W. Unlock: 1500 forge residue. Does nothing by itself until installed in a compatible chassis.

ThingDef.label: cinder mortar core
ThingDef.description: Slot: Main weapon. Compatible chassis: Medium. Role: indirect cinder bombardment. Effect: lobs cinder-packed shells over cover to punish clustered enemies and static firing lines. Each hit creates compact explosive splash and a short-lived hot-ash residue patch. Range: 40.0. Minimum range: 8.0. Charge: 0.4s before firing; cadence modules reduce this charge time. Cooldown: 5.6s after firing. Burst: 1. Extra module power draw: +320 W. Unlock: 820 forge residue. Does nothing by itself until installed in a compatible chassis.

ThingDef.label: null-arc discharger
ThingDef.description: Slot: Main weapon. Compatible chassis: Medium. Role: null-arc EMP suppression. Effect: charges a sanctified capacitor, then fires a thin EMP/null-arc pulse. The primary hit applies EMP pressure and moderate damage, then chains to up to three nearby hostile pawns with reduced force. Strong against mechanoids, shield belts, and clustered elite support; weak as pure DPS against unshielded flesh. Range: 36.0. Charge: 0.6s before firing; cadence modules reduce this charge time. Cooldown: 5.8s after firing. Burst: 1. Extra module power draw: +380 W. Unlock: 960 forge residue. Does nothing by itself until installed in a compatible chassis.

ThingDef.label: abyssal harpoon projector
ThingDef.description: Slot: Main weapon. Compatible chassis: Medium. Role: anti-breach elite lockdown. Effect: fires a heavy abyssal anchor-spike that pierces dangerous targets, applies a visible tether, slows movement, reduces melee dodge, and can micro-yank non-boss enemies one or two cells toward the chassis. Bosses and huge pawns receive only a reduced tether and cannot be pulled. Range: 32.0. Minimum range: 4.0. Charge: 0.5s before firing; cadence modules reduce this charge time. Cooldown: 7.0s after firing. Burst: 1. Extra module power draw: +340 W. Unlock: 1040 forge residue. Does nothing by itself until installed in a compatible chassis.

ThingDef.label: vesper lance array
ThingDef.description: Slot: Main weapon. Compatible chassis: Medium. Role: charged precision sanction lance. Effect: replaces the turret main weapon with a focused Vesper sanction beam for armored targets, dangerous elites, and measured long-lane pressure. It charges briefly, then releases a hard-hitting high-velocity lance with cleaner cadence than the Sepulcher rail. Range: 40.5. Charge: 0.7s before firing; cadence modules reduce this charge time. Cooldown: 5.2s after firing. Burst: 1. Extra module power draw: +260 W. Unlock: 680 forge residue. Does nothing by itself until installed in a compatible chassis.
